text:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we're assembling a 6-8 org private beta for the 'Private Deployment' flow. need to lock partner selection criteria, onboarding cadence, and the minimal launch gates. thoughts?
Samir Khan: sounds good. heads-up: any org with strict network isolation will need a VPC peering doc + KMS handshake. that's non-trivial for infra.
Alesha Reed: agree. for recruitment we should weight by 1) security posture 2) integration complexity 3) potential impact (revenue/strategic). maybe a simple scorecard.
Jordan (PM): +1 on scorecard. also want explicit acceptance criteria: minimal perf (p50/p95), error budget, and at least 2 customer-driven success stories (short writeups).
Lee - Eng: engineering reality check: we can support 3 partners in week 1, then ramp to 6 by week 4. need feature-flagged rollout and a canary for key telemetry hooks.
Maya Patel: proposal: recruit 6 partners, prioritize 3 with lowest infra lift for week 1, 3 high-value for week 3. onboarding = 3 weeks (setup, integration, QA). weekly sync + async bug board.
Samir Khan: add compliance checklist: NDA signed, IP/data boundary ack, SOC/ISO questionnaire if requested. also require a point of contact who can do infra-level troubleshooting.
Alesha Reed: incentives: $10k credits + dedicated onboarding hours + co-marketing for successful pilots. offer early access pricing for 6 months post-launch. keeps them engaged.
Jordan (PM): can we make launch gates concrete? propose the following thresholds:
```
- Latency: p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 450ms for standard small-batch workloads
- Availability: >= 99.5% during their steady-state window
- Quality: no regressions on 95% of our eval prompt set vs baseline model
- Integration: 2 successful end-to-end workflows validated by partner (smoke + regression)
```
Lee - Eng: those are fine but p95 450ms depends on model choice/quant. we should allow model-tier exemptions and specify fallback policy (route to hosted variant) when local variant misses SLO.
Maya Patel: agreed. i'll add a routing fallback clause: if private instance > SLO for 10m, auto-failover to hosted with partner consent. log everything.
Samir Khan: operational items: add runbook for incident handoff, list of allowed ops for partner engineers, and an SLA addendum in the pilot contract.
Alesha Reed: for feedback loops: weekly 30m touch + bi-weekly product review + a post-run retrospective. plus a short NPS and feature ranking survey after first month.
Jordan (PM): need metrics to evaluate success post-pilot. suggested capture: time-to-first-successful-inference, tokens/sec, avg cost-per-token, number of infra incidents, partner satisfaction score.
Maya Patel: +1. can someone draft a 1-page partner scorecard template? columns: selection_score, onboarding_days, uptime, latency_p95, incidents, satisfaction.
Lee - Eng: i'll do the template and include the observability queries we'll need. expect a PR by EOD Friday.
Samir Khan: legal — i'll push the NDA + pilot SLA drafts to the shared drive and tag @Jordan when ready.
Jordan (PM): assigning owners: Maya = recruitment & comms, Lee = engineering onboarding & observability, Samir = compliance & contracts, Alesha = incentives & partner ops. sound good?
Alesha Reed: sounds good to me.
Maya Patel: ok i'll kick off outreach tomorrow, target kickoff week after next. posting the draft scorecard in #product later today. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: private-beta-docs v1 -> docs.redwood.internal at 2026-03-24T18:00Z
Lee - Eng: noted. will align canary window with that.
Jordan (PM): thanks everyone — small follow-ups in the doc thread.
Maya Patel: thanks, team.
